description: Default target-device / target-platform acceptance checklist derived from the catalog's Core Acceptance Reference. Used by `tools-offline-app-dev.py accept`. Each check has an id, what to do, and the severity assigned when it FAILS (fail = release blocker, warn = documented and owned). Observations are recorded per run in a results JSON; see knowledge-readme.md for the schema.

checks.description: A clean machine installs the complete local toolchain from the offline bundle with no first-run download
checks.evidence_hint: installer log from a network-blocked clean VM/machine

checks.description: Locked dependencies restore from local caches (hashes verified), then the debug and release builds succeed with network access blocked
checks.evidence_hint: restore log + build exit codes; hash verification output

checks.description: The application installs and launches on the target device/simulator from the built artifact (not from the IDE)
checks.evidence_hint: screen recording or screenshot + install log

checks.description: The application stores data and completes a schema migration from the previous release(s) without data loss
checks.evidence_hint: migration test log from N-1 (and N-2) fixtures; record counts before/after

checks.description: The application survives process death and restart: state is restored or safely re-established; no corruption
checks.evidence_hint: kill -9 / task switcher force-stop test notes

checks.description: Denied permissions (camera, location, notifications, storage, biometrics) are handled: feature degrades with clear UX, no crash, no infinite prompt
checks.evidence_hint: per-permission test notes + screenshots on device

checks.description: Upgrade from the previous release preserves user data; rollback to the previous release preserves user data (or recovery path verified)
checks.evidence_hint: upgrade/rollback rehearsal log with record checksums

checks.description: Automated unit tests pass on the target platform toolchain
checks.evidence_hint: test report artifact

checks.description: Automated integration tests (persistence, sync engine offline, migrations) pass
checks.evidence_hint: test report artifact

checks.description: Automated UI tests pass on representative simulators/emulators and at least one physical device per mobile target
checks.evidence_hint: UI test report + device model list

checks.description: Accessibility automated and manual checks pass: screen reader traversal, 200% font scale, focus order, contrast, hit targets
checks.evidence_hint: a11y scan output + manual checklist on device

checks.description: Security checks pass: no secrets in artifacts, dependency audit clean for known-critical CVEs, platform signing/sandbox rules honored
checks.evidence_hint: SBOM + audit report + artifact scan output

checks.description: Localization checks pass: pseudo-locale coverage, no clipped strings at 200% scale, RTL layout sanity where supported
checks.evidence_hint: screenshots in pseudo-locale + RTL on/off

checks.description: Offline behavior tests pass: all core journeys complete with network blocked; no hidden first-run download attempts (observed via blocked proxy or airplane mode)
checks.evidence_hint: airplane-mode test notes; proxy/firewall log showing zero unexpected egress

checks.description: Performance budgets honored: cold start, frame time, memory ceiling, binary size, per the signed performance baseline
checks.evidence_hint: profiler trace + metrics table vs budget

checks.description: Release artifacts are reproducible where the platform permits (rebuild produces identical hashes or an explained delta)
checks.evidence_hint: two clean-build hashes compared; delta analysis if any

checks.description: Artifacts are signed with controlled keys; signing identity and timestamp recorded; no signing keys in source or build inputs
checks.evidence_hint: signature verification output; key custody record reference

checks.description: Artifacts accompanied by checksums, SBOM, license manifest, and privacy declarations
checks.evidence_hint: release record listing all four artifacts

checks.description: Rollback instructions are written, tested, and reference exact artifact versions and data-format compatibility
checks.evidence_hint: rollback rehearsal log

checks.description: Features that require external infrastructure (push, payments, store submission, remote backend) degrade clearly when offline and are verified separately in controlled connected environments
checks.evidence_hint: airplane-mode UX screenshots for each infra-dependent feature + connected-environment verification report reference
